title: Charts and maps: Tracking oil and US gas prices amid Iran conflict | CNN Business
text:
Source: CNN

Global oil and US gas prices are climbing again after anescalation in hostilitiesbetween the United States and Iran.Prices eased over the summer after the United States and Iran signed apeace plan to end the warin June, butan escalation in military action in late Augustreversed that decline.

US gas prices are back above an average $4 a gallon. In June, after the peace plan was signed, gasoline prices dropped below the $4 threshold for the first time since March 30, according to theAAA, but that trajectory has now changed course.

The US national average diesel price hit arecordhigh a this week, according to AAA data.

See the average price of a gallon of gasoline in each state and how it has changed since the beginning of the US-Israeli war with Iran.

Gasoline pricesreached their highest level in more than three years in the early stages of the war with Iran, before dropping off after the June peace plan was signed. Prices have begun to climb again amid renewed hostilities in recent weeks.

— CNN’s Chris Isidore contributed to this report.
